source_message.text:
Hi,

Thank you for sending over the updated version. This is much closer to what I was looking for, and I'm happy with the overall design direction now. I do not think it needs another redesign - just a final tidy-up before sign-off.

Please could you make the following final amendments:

1\. Assessment date placeholder

On page one, the report currently says:

"Assessment Date: Assessment Date.”

Please change this to either:
“Assessment Date: \[Assessment Date\]”

or leave it as an editable date field that I can update for each customer.

2\. Typo correction

On page 2, the wording currently says:
“Owners often overrate gated drivers.”

Please change this to:
“Owners often overrate gated driveways.”

3\. Awkward sentence correction

On page 2, the sentence currently says:

“Assessment note: Storage is helping presentations slightly...”

Please change this to:

“Assessment note: Storage slightly improves the vehicle’s security presentation, but not enough to offset the wider weaknesses in the setup.”

4\. Page 4 footer

Pages 1, 2 and 3 have a consistent footer. Still, page 4 does not appear to have the same footer because of the distribution warning section.

Please can you restore the standard footer on page 4 so that the footer is consistent across the full report.

5\. Final distribution warning section

I like the distribution warning, but it still feels slightly too dominant at the bottom of page 4. Please could you reduce or refine it slightly so it remains clear and professional, but does not overpower the page or interfere with the footer.

Once these changes are made, I think the report will be ready for sign-off.

Thanks

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi,

Thank you for sending over the updated report design. The overall direction is much stronger now, and I'm happy with the general look and feel, so I do not want to redesign it from scratch.

I would like to make a final round of refinements to improve readability, consistency, and the overall commercial finish before I sign it off.

The main changes I'd like are:

1\. Make the front-page score more dominant.

Please make the "22/100" score slightly larger and give it more breathing room so it feels more like the main dashboard result. The customer should immediately notice the score and risk outcome when they open the report.

2\. Rename "Security Score" to "Vehicle Security Score"

On the front page, please change the heading from "Security Score" to "Vehicle Security Score" to make it feel more complete and professional.

3\. Simplify the "What Caused This Result" section.

The wording is good, but the dark blue panel currently feels quite text-heavy. Please reduce this section into shorter, easier-to-scan bullet points. For example:

\- No independent immobilisation
\- No circular steering lock
\- No live-location tracking
\- Storage location is being overvalued
\- Owner security habits reduce protection

The longer explanation can remain elsewhere in the report if needed. Still, page one should feel more immediate and easy to read.

4\. Remove placeholder text

Please remove any placeholder text such as "Click to enter a date." This should either be replaced with the actual assessment date or a clean editable placeholder such as "\[Assessment Date\]".

5\. Check report code consistency

Please check that the report code is consistent throughout. I noticed some areas may show "PR-01". This should be "RR-01" throughout unless there is a specific reason for using something different.

6\. Clean up the vehicle group section

The checkboxes next to Range Rover / Range Rover Sport / Defender make the section feel slightly like a form rather than a completed report. Please either make this a cleaner fixed line, such as:

"Vehicle Group: Range Rover / Range Rover Sport / Defender"

or make it customer-specific, for example:

"Vehicle Assessed: Range Rover Sport"

7\. Add a subtle header to pages 2 onwards

The footer works well, but I'd also like a subtle header across the internal pages for consistency. Something simple would be fine, such as:

"Vehicle Theft Risk Assessment | RR-01 | Confidential"

This should be subtle and not take up too much space.

8\. Refine the red distribution warning on the final page

I like the idea of the warning section, but the red block currently feels a little too heavy. Please keep the warning, but make it slightly more refined and less visually dominant, while still making it clear that the report is confidential and for limited distribution.

Overall, I'm happy with the design direction. I want this final round to focus on polish, readability, consistency and making the report feel like a premium paid assessment.

Please let me know if the above changes are clear and when you expect to send the revised version.

Thanks

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi,

In reports RR02 and RR03 in the “What Owners Often Overestimate” section it states:

“This matters because false confidence is one of the clearest features of a severe exposure setup.”

Please change this to:

“This matters because false confidence can weaken an otherwise reasonable security setup over time.”

After making this change we can consider the project complete. So, when you are finished please send the editable source files that will allow me to export customer-ready PDFs myself.

Thanks

value_updates.source_file_handoff_timing: Send the editable source files after completing the RR02 and RR03 wording change so the client can export customer-ready PDFs.
